audit_metadata.title: Sprint 6.0.2 Source-Level Fee Formula & Equity Reconciliation Audit

brokerage.specification: min(0.03% * turnover, Rs 20) per execution order
brokerage.implementation: min(20.0, turnover * 0.0003) for Buy AND min(20.0, turnover * 0.0003) for Sell
brokerage.reporting: In Sprint 6.0 report Section 3, estimated as 621 * Rs 20 (omitted sell-side leg in narrative table). In Sprint 6.0.1, identified as Rs 24,840.00.

stt.specification: 0.10% on Buy delivery turnover + 0.10% on Sell delivery turnover
stt.implementation: turnover * 0.001 on Buy leg + turnover * 0.001 on Sell leg
stt.reporting: Report approximated turnover base using invested capital. Recomputed independently to Rs 114,137.05.

stamp_duty.specification: 0.015% on Buy turnover only; Rs 0 on Sell
stamp_duty.implementation: turnover * 0.00015 on Buy leg; 0.0 on Sell leg
stamp_duty.reporting: Report approximated turnover base. Recomputed independently to Rs 8,556.20.

exchange_charges.implementation: turnover * 0.0000297 on Buy + turnover * 0.0000297 on Sell
exchange_charges.reporting: Report approximated turnover base. Recomputed independently to Rs 3,390.06.

sebi_charges.specification: Rs 10 per Crore (0.0001%) on turnover for both legs
sebi_charges.implementation: turnover * 0.000001 on Buy + turnover * 0.000001 on Sell
sebi_charges.reporting: Report approximated turnover base. Recomputed independently to Rs 113.82.

gst.implementation: (brokerage + exchange_fee + sebi_fee) * 0.18 on Buy and Sell legs
gst.reporting: Report narrative table calculated GST on one-leg brokerage only. Recomputed independently to Rs 5,101.93.

slippage.specification: 5 bps (0.05%) execution slippage on entry and exit
slippage.implementation: exec_entry_price = raw_entry_open * 1.0005; exec_exit_price = raw_exit_open * 0.9995. Slippage tracked as turnover * 0.0005.
slippage.double_counting_audit: PASS (Gross P&L is computed from raw prices, not execution prices, so subtracting total_costs which includes slippage deducts slippage exactly once, matching net cash change).

test_independence_assessment.sprint_6_0_2_tests: Implemented tests/test_reconciliation_6_0_2.py with 100% independent calculation logic
